mechanism: Nafcillin induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially reducing paroxetine metabolism and increasing paroxetine levels, while paroxetine inhibits CYP2D6 which may affect nafcillin metabolism minimally.
action: Monitor for increased paroxetine side effects (serotonin syndrome, bleeding, hyponatremia); consider paroxetine dose adjustment if nafcillin is initiated or discontinued during concurrent therapy.
